categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies CBlockIndex in src/chain.h, the core in-memory data structure for block index management.
categories.rationale: Reordering CBlockIndex struct fields eliminates compiler padding to save 8 bytes per block, reducing resident memory by roughly 8 MB for 1M blocks. This is a minor memory optimization with negligible practical impact on overall node performance, making it marginal for review attention.
